home-heading: Welcome to Paint&Wine, the first painting studio in Skopje that brings together fun, art, and wine!
contact-sub-heading: We'd love to hear from you.
picture-section-header: Looking for a different kind of night and memories worth keeping?
picture-section-header-2: Paint&Wine is the place where creativity meets fun.
paragraph1: Paint on canvas with acrylics, enjoy a glass of premium wine from small Macedonian wineries, and discover your inner artist. Perfect for relaxing, socializing, and great vibes – no prior experience needed.
paragraph2: Just bring good energy. We’ll take care of the rest.
paragraph3: Reserve your spot today and experience a unique evening filled with art and good wine.
paragraph4: At our Paint & Wine events, you unleash your creativity. With a brush in hand and a glass of fine wine, you paint under the guidance of our instructors, creating beautiful memories and artistic masterpieces. The perfect way to relax, have fun, and enjoy a unique experience with friends.
about-us-paragraph: Paint&Wine is the first painting studio in Skopje where fun and art go hand in hand with a glass of wine. Come, have fun, and explore your creative side! Don’t miss the chance to leave with a smile and your very own masterpiece!
about-workshops-paragraph: Paint & Wine is a perfect way to spend a fantastic evening with friends or simply to hang out and meet new people.
your-artwork-paragraph: The painting you create during the event is yours to keep, and we provide everything you need – canvas, paint, and of course, wine! The only thing you need to bring is a smile and positive energy!
experience-paragraph: And don’t worry! You don’t need any painting experience – our artist will guide you step by step through the entire fun painting process, so there’s no way to make a mistake!
atmosphere-paragraph: Think you can't paint? Relax and let us help you discover the hidden artist inside you!
reservation-text: Ready to join us? Reserve your seat by sending us a message!
private-event-min-guests-note: A minimum of 15 guests is required for a private event.
form-success-message: Successfully submitted! We'll get back to you soon.
privacy-policy-intro-text: Paint & Wine Skopje ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or participate in our events. Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the site.

The personal information that we collect may include: name, email address, phone number, and any other information you choose to provide. We also automatically collect certain information when you visit our website, including your IP address, browser type, operating system, access times, and the pages you have viewed directly before and after accessing the website.
privacy-policy-info-use-text: We use the information we collect to: process your event registrations and bookings; send you confirmations, updates, and administrative messages; respond to your inquiries and provide customer service; send you marketing communications about our events and services (you may opt-out at any time); improve our website and services; monitor and analyze trends, usage, and activities; detect, prevent, and address technical issues and security incidents; and comply with legal obligations.
privacy-policy-data-protection-text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect the security of any personal information we process. However, please note that no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
privacy-policy-cookies-text: We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to access or store information. Cookies are small data files stored on your device. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our website.
privacy-policy-third-party-text: We may share your information with third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as payment processing, email delivery, and website hosting. These third parties are obligated to protect your information and use it only for the purposes for which it was disclosed. Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these third-party sites.
privacy-policy-your-rights-text: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information, including: the right to access your personal information; the right to correct inaccurate information; the right to request deletion of your information; the right to object to or restrict processing of your information; and the right to data portability. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.
